ratings_why.fun: Seating puzzles (Coronella's left, Anguis's neighbours, Mixer between carries) and the Saucer's three-way choice give real decisions every turn, and shop rehearsals let the board grow without fighting.
ratings_why.distinct: The Death Scene core is a familiar Deathrattle tribe with a Rivendare (Old Crest), but going limp, fooling both sides and the Curtain Call second board play unlike any tribe today.

verdict_why: The v1 loops are closed and nothing left is broken; more passes would change cards, not improve the web of interactions.

points.text: Coronella is the best Johnny card: she turns any neighbour's death effect, a Belly or an Ardea meal into a Start of Combat payoff. Keep her exactly as she is.
Say on the Millpond Maid and Old Crest that their extra triggers add up (Maid plus Crest is three plays), so players can plan the stack without reading the rationale.
Chorus Snake does one obvious job. A small hook, such as getting up with +1 Attack after a Curtain Call, would give the Tier 1 seed a reason to stay on a late board.

Shed-Skin Dresser on another tribe's unit (an Ooze that empties its Belly and gets up hungry, a Soak unit) is where the hidden combos live; one more card that rewards a lent Play Dead would deepen build D.

standouts.why: Positional forced death at Start of Combat feeds Berus, Hesketh, Bellies and Ardea, each in a different way.
Copies any neighbour's death effect, including other tribes', so seating decides what the Tail carries.
Rehearsing scenes in the shop, and on Hesketh under Old Crest, is the tribe's best surprise.

weakest.why: A vanilla body with Play Dead; nothing to arrange around it.
A straight gold drip that asks no decision once the board goes down a lot.
Wreath-Weaver is a plainer Mixer that only adds a Play Dead filter.

flags.note: Hesketh with Old Crest, Prompt-Box Eft and Saucers multiplies every scene in the shop each turn, and golden copies reach far higher; buying and reselling Efts repeats it for gold.
Coronella plus Berus plus extra triggers destroys enemies before any attack; positional counterplay exists but is thin.
Extra lives on every Play Dead unit with Bufo feeding each fall can make several Curtain Calls of a growing board.
